subject: physical-education

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of choosing a second activity deliberately unlike the first in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe the technical model for the second activity using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply transfer: what carried over and what had to be relearned in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving managing two development goals without overloading; correct it and explain why.
Connect comparing the two activities on sustainability and access with deciding which to carry into Grade 12 and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Run a second documented development block in a contrasting activity and write a transfer analysis explaining what carried across from Pathway A and what did not.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Specialization Pathway B?
